# GuessUp — Motion-Activated Party Charades Game & Playtest Portal

> GuessUp is a high-energy, motion-activated party charades game designed for Indian pop culture, party hangouts, and hostel game nights. Players hold their phone to their forehead while teammates shout clues, tilting the device down to score a point or up to pass.

## Core Application Overview
- **Game Name**: GuessUp
- **Platform**: Web (Interactive Demo & Admin Portal) + Android (Official Google Play Closed Beta)
- **Developer**: Shrey Nagda
- **Official Domain**: https://guessup-game.netlify.app/
- **Key Categories & Decks**: Bollywood Buff 🎬, Cricket Fever 🏏, Sweet & Spicy 🍔, Incredible India 🇮🇳, Aamchi Mumbai 🏙️

## Key Features & Technology Specs
- **60 FPS Motion Sensing**: Uses native device accelerometer and gyroscope to detect forehead tilt gestures (down = correct, up = pass).
- **Zero Ad Interruptions**: 100% uninterrupted gameplay with no unskippable video ads between rounds.
- **Game Modes**: Solo Casual Mode and 2-Team Battle Mode (Team A vs Team B with automated scoreboards).
- **Custom Deck Creation**: Built-in engine allowing players to create custom trivia decks.

## Web Portal Routing Structure
- `/` - Main Landing Page featuring the Interactive Playable Demo, Features, Community Hall of Fame, and Playtester Registration Form.
- `/admin` - Secure Admin Suite for deck content management, tester status monitoring, and player feedback.
- `/privacy` - Official Google Play Verification Legal Privacy Policy detailing zero-PII data governance and RAM motion sensor handling.

## Beta Playtester Program
Playtesters can request early closed testing access on the Google Play Store via the inline form on the landing page or the API endpoint below:
- **API Endpoint**: `POST /.netlify/functions/send-invite`
- **Payload Schema**: `{ "email": "user@gmail.com", "name": "Optional Name" }`
- **Response Schema**: `{ "success": true, "message": "Invite email sent successfully!", "docId": "string" }`
